title: Landing page redesign + three launch social media pieces

terms.label: Scope of work
terms.value: Provider will redesign Client's landing page and create three social media pieces for Client's upcoming product launch.

terms.label: Delivery date
terms.value: Provider will deliver the redesigned landing page and the three social media pieces by Friday, October 23, 2026.

terms.label: Project fee
terms.value: Client will pay Provider a fixed fee of $1,200 USD for the landing page redesign and the three social media pieces.

terms.label: Payment schedule
terms.value: Client will pay 50% of the fee ($600 USD) upfront. Client will pay the remaining 50% ($600 USD) when Provider delivers the final files.

terms.label: Revisions
terms.value: The fee includes two rounds of revisions. Provider will bill any revisions after those two rounds at $60 USD per hour.

terms.label: Source files
terms.value: Provider will deliver the Figma source file and every exported asset to Client.

terms.label: Start date
terms.value: Provider will start work on Monday, October 5, 2026.
